lines.text: The Spirit brings Ezekiel to the east gate, where twenty-five men stand, and the LORD says they plot evil.
The LORD says He will remove the men from the city and deliver them into the hands of Egyptians.
While Ezekiel is prophesying, Pelatiah son of Benaiah dies, and Ezekiel falls facedown and cries out to the Lord GOD.
God promises to remove their heart of stone and give them a heart of bronze.
The glory of the LORD stands over the mountain east of the city, and Ezekiel tells the exiles everything.
